method: Each question ran through python -m text2sql by its questions.yaml id. Inputs refused by layer 1 and raw-SQL inputs needed no LLM. For the others, an sql-proposer agent could read only the layer-2 prompt file (schema, rules and the question; no id, category or expect) and its JSON reply was passed to the pipeline unchanged. Each trace was then judged by /question-review, forked into its own question-reviewer agent given only the trace id. The traces and reviews were copied verbatim from the JSONL logs by python -m text2sql results.
